arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Low left-facing worker crouch. Far/tool arm sweeps diagonally UPPER-LEFT, holding ONE short dark charcoal hammer above and left of the head in the precise diagonal source orientation. Near/free arm extends down-left to a separate low hand. Face looks down-left with one eye. Torso horizontal, supporting leg underneath and other leg bent back toward screen-right. Preserve two separate arm paths; do not add second hand on hammer. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
